newsitem.title: INDIA: Indian metals' steady, industrial demand low.
newsitem.headline: Indian metals' steady, industrial demand low.

text.p: Indian metals' were steady in a narrow trading range on low industrial demand on Monday, dealers said.
Copper was steady at 11,750 rupees per quintal. It was up by 100 rupees during last week.
Dealers said that zinc was unchanged at 6,200 rupees and lead at 4,925 rupees amid thin activity.
Major players kept away awaiting an announcement of the selling prices for second half October by state-owned Hindustan Copper and Hindustan Zinc Ltd.
